data.description:
## Context
Compare rebar's author-facing guidance for writing a passing plan with the deterministic criteria currently contributing to the clarity measure. Identify meaningful, mechanically testable additions without changing code.

## Plan
- Read the packaged plan-writing guide and relevant plan-review criteria documentation.
- Locate the current clarity measure and enumerate its deterministic inputs.
- Map documented guidance to candidate checks, filtering out semantic judgments that cannot be reliably deterministic.
- Recommend prioritized criteria, including detection rules, likely failure modes, and false-positive controls.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Current clarity checks and documented plan-writing guidance are compared using repository citations.
- [ ] Each recommended criterion has a deterministic detection rule and rationale.
- [ ] Recommendations distinguish strong additions from checks that should remain LLM-reviewed.
- [ ] Findings are recorded on this ticket.
data.title: Assess deterministic clarity criteria against plan-writing guidance
